decisive_spans.text: Two symmetrical solitary erythematous nodules were present in the right and left inguinal folds adjacent to the scrotum
Epidermal ulceration overlying a diffuse dermal proliferation composed of sheets of histiocytes with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies measuring 5-8 μm in diameter

response.rationale: D3 is a perfect match, as it includes all the key histopathological findings and the clinical presentation of the nodules. D1 is a good match for the histopathological findings but lacks the clinical context of the nodules.
